canonical_source.behavior: When Href is absent, AppButton renders a real button with the configured type/title, native disabled behavior, aria-busy and aria-pressed state, and dispatches the supplied OnClick callback. Busy state renders a spinner while retaining the button content.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The shared React AppButton renders a native non-link button, preserves type/title/aria-label/aria-busy/aria-pressed, relies on native disabled click suppression, dispatches the supplied React click callback, and is exercised by the real Runtime Error Recover control. Consumer-specific canonical identity remains separate through canonicalOperationId while the shared component identity is retained as data-canonical-component-operation.

authorization.reason: This shared control dispatches an already-authorized consumer callback and does not grant permissions, select a tenant, or call a backend endpoint by itself. Authorization remains the responsibility of the owning runtime action.

tenant_isolation.proof: The component accepts no tenant or resource identifier and constructs no route. The production wiring preserves the existing Runtime Error Recover behavior and authenticated application tree without changing tenant context.

degraded_and_retry_semantics.busy: aria-busy is exposed without fabricating success or silently changing the disabled contract.
degraded_and_retry_semantics.retry: No internal retry is performed; each enabled user activation dispatches the supplied callback once and the consumer owns any retry/idempotency semantics.

acceptance_tests.coverage: exact canonical marker, native button/type/title, OnClick dispatch, native disabled suppression, busy/pressed accessibility state, spinner/content behavior, and real Runtime Error Recover production wiring without canonical-marker collision
existing consumer regression proving local recovery, no navigation/network mutation, and fail-safe recurrence when the child still throws

terminality.basis: The source-equivalent non-link AppButton behavior is implemented in a reusable production React component, exercised by a real runtime consumer, and covered by deterministic focused acceptance without adding authority, persistence, or route semantics.
